fpp-hud.title: Always-on 12-line help panel covers subtitles, E prompt, chapter card and inventory chip
fpp-hud.repro: Start a new game at 1280x720 (G.mat.newGame('survivor')). Look at the lower right during the opening card and the first dialogue, then mount a horse.
fpp-hud.evidence: In shots/qa_story/a01_card.png the panel covers 'SUMMER · THE VALLEY' on the chapter card. In a02_dialogue.png the inventory chip is clipped to 'Your hands are empt'. In a04/b01/c01 the dialogue subtitle text runs into the panel. In c01/c02 the E prompt pill is clipped to 'Dismount Daw…'. index.html:32 #help has no toggle or timeout, and main.js never hides it outside the cine classes. The panel is about 565x260 px.
fpp-hud.suggested_fix: Show the help panel only for the first few minutes or on F1/H, and fade it after inactivity. Otherwise collapse it to a one-line 'F1 controls' hint. At minimum, raise #sub, #prompt and #inv above it or move #help so it does not overlap the bottom-centre band. This also fixes the known FPP weapon overlap.

fpp-hud.title: 'Your hands are empty' chip shows while fists are drawn and the weapon bar is visible
fpp-hud.repro: Start a new game. The weapon bar shows '1 Fists (selected) / 2 Axe / 3 Spear' while the inventory chip at the bottom says 'Your hands are empty'.
fpp-hud.evidence: qa.log: inv = 'Your hands are empty', wpn = '1Fists2Axe3Spear…'. In a01_card.png the two show together. drawInv (main.js 308) falls back to that string whenever there are no tools or items.
fpp-hud.suggested_fix: Change the fallback to 'Nothing carried', or hide #inv when it is empty. Only say 'hands empty' when W.held is null and no torch is lit.

fpp-hud.title: Help panel is always on and covers the first-person weapon hand, the inventory chip and subtitles at 1280x720
fpp-hud.repro: Viewport 1280x720, New game (Survivor), then V for first person and draw the spear (3). The #help panel (568x265 px at right 18px, bottom 18px) covers the lower-right 44% of the screen. The spear hand and shaft are behind it (g05). The #inv chip (left 562 to right 718) is clipped by the panel (left 694), so it reads 'Your hands are empt'. The intro subtitle #sub (bottom 96px) prints on top of the help text. Sena is partly hidden behind it in third person.
fpp-hud.evidence: shots/qa-fpp/a02_hud720.jpg, g01_fists_chip.jpg, g05_fpp_spear_up.jpg, b02_fpp_lookdown.jpg. getBoundingClientRect: help {x:694,y:437,w:568,h:265}, inv {x:562,right:718}. index.html line 32 '#help' has no hide or toggle logic anywhere in main.js.
fpp-hud.suggested_fix: Make the help panel collapsible: show a 1-line '? Help (F1)' chip by default, expand on F1 or hold, and auto-collapse after the first 60 s of play. Add a Game-tab setting 'Show controls'. At least add a media query for max-height:800px that hides it or shrinks it to 2 columns, and hide it in first person while a weapon is drawn. Raise #sub above the panel or hide the panel while a subtitle is on.

fpp-hud.title: First person: no look limit while seated or riding (you can look straight back into Sena's face)
fpp-hud.repro: Ride a tamed horse with Sena behind (G.setCh('herd'); G.tame(); within 10 m of Sena), V for first person, then mouse-look 180 degrees (or G.yaw=G.P.face). The view turns freely through 360 degrees and lands about 0.3 m from Sena's face. The same happens sitting at the fire or on the bench.
fpp-hud.evidence: main.js:8050-8058 applyLook: 'camYaw -= lookX * k' with no clamp; only the pitch is clamped (pitchMin/fppPitchMax). The FPP verification notes record 'looking 180 deg back puts her face ~0.3 m away'.
fpp-hud.suggested_fix: In first person while P.ride, P.sit>0, a seat or rest, clamp the yaw relative to the body (P.face+PI) to plus or minus 110 degrees (riding) or 120 degrees (seated) with a soft spring at the edge. To look further, turn the horse or stand up. Keep TPP free.

fpp-hud.title: First person: spear held with one hand only
fpp-hud.repro: Give the spear, select 3, draw, V for first person, wait until G.wpn.vm().weapon==='spear' and the raise completes. The shaft runs from the lower right to the crosshair, held by the right hand only; there is no left hand on the shaft (third person holds it two-handed). The spearhead is also hard to read at the crosshair.
fpp-hud.evidence: shots/qa-fpp/g05_fpp_spear_up.jpg. FPP verification 'Remaining: Spear in first person is held by the right hand only'.
fpp-hud.suggested_fix: In fppVm, when the spear is held, IK the left arm (fpArm('l', ...)) to a grip point about 0.45 m forward along the shaft (FIT.spear front-grip), the same as the third-person GRIP_L. Rotate the shaft so the flint head sits slightly right of and below the crosshair and is visible.

fpp-hud.title: 'Your hands are empty' chip shows while the fists are raised
fpp-hud.repro: New game, press 1 then hold Q (or G.wpn.select('fists'); G.wpn.draw()). Aro raises his fists in a guard, but the inventory chip still reads 'Your hands are empty'. The text comes from drawInv when there are no tools or items, so it contradicts the fists and stays until something is picked up.
fpp-hud.evidence: shots/qa-fpp/g01_fists_chip.jpg. main.js:308 "$('inv').innerHTML = h || 'Your hands are empty'". G.wpn.state() showed {sel:'fists', st:'drawn'} with inv text 'Your hands are empty'.
fpp-hud.suggested_fix: Change the empty text to 'Nothing carried' (it describes the inventory, not the hands), or hide the chip when empty. If the hands wording stays, suppress it while W.held is set or torchOn is true.

fpp-hud.title: Mirror Lake sits in a steep, perfectly circular 12 m crater
fpp-hud.repro: G.time(9); G.tp(-95,138); G.yaw=Math.PI (looking north across the lake). The lake is a round disc with a hard circular edge at the bottom of a bowl whose banded mud walls rise about 12 m in 10 m. Heights: G.h(-95,150)=-1.2, G.h(-95,140)=10.8, G.h(-95,130)=12.1. It reads as a quarry pit, not a lake.
fpp-hud.evidence: shots/qa-fpp/h05_lake_shore.jpg; also h04_lake.jpg (a wall of cracked mud texture from the water).
fpp-hud.suggested_fix: In world.js features(), give the lake basin a wide smoothstep falloff (shore slope 1:4 or gentler over about 25 m), noise the radius (plus or minus 15% with low-frequency noise) so the outline is irregular, and add a reed or pebble beach band at the waterline. Clamp slopes near the lake so the banded cliff texture does not show.

fpp-hud.title: The help panel covers the bottom-centre interaction prompt and subtitles
fpp-hud.repro: Any new game before pointer lock (help shown): stand at the house door. The prompt shows as 'E Nap for a whil…', cut off by the help panel. Subtitles ('Long before the first word…', Sena's lines) run underneath the panel.
fpp-hud.evidence: shots/qa-rst/13_house.jpg, 15_inside.jpg, 21_house_done.jpg, 31_sit_fire.jpg, 32_spring.jpg. The help panel spans x 695-1262, y 350-612 at 1280×720 and overlaps the prompt at y about 383 and the subtitle at y about 522. Sena is also hidden behind it in the hot-spring shot.
fpp-hud.suggested_fix: Show the help panel only for the first N seconds, toggle it with H/F1, or shrink it and anchor it above the inventory bar in the right column (bottom: 90px, max-height 40vh). Hide it while #restmenu, a subtitle or the prompt would overlap, or move the prompt above the panel's top.

fpp-hud.title: First-person spear is held one-handed at normal view
fpp-hud.repro: Press V, draw the spear (3), look level (pitch 0).
fpp-hud.evidence: v4_spear.png in g_v2.png: only the right fist on the shaft. When looking down (v5) a second arm appears, so the two views disagree. Sprint (v6) is also one-handed.
fpp-hud.suggested_fix: Add the left fist to the vmSpear rig up the shaft, matching the third-person spearStance (0.42 m along the shaft), except while sprinting or when the torch is lit.

fpp-hud.title: No look limit while seated or riding in first person: you can look straight back into Sena's face
fpp-hud.repro: Ride two-up, press V, set yaw = P.face (look backward).
fpp-hud.evidence: g_fr.png: Sena's face fills the screen and a dark triangular spear shaft cuts across the view. applyLook clamps only pitch.
fpp-hud.suggested_fix: While P.ride, P.sit or in a seat, clamp wrapA(camYaw - P.face - PI) to about ±110°. Or turn the shoulders and hide nearby passenger and back-slot meshes past 100°.

fpp-hud.title: Help panel covers the first-person weapon, subtitles and inventory
fpp-hud.repro: Help panel visible (default), first person, draw the spear or axe at 1280x720.
fpp-hud.evidence: g_v.png: the spear viewmodel is completely hidden behind the 12-line help panel in the lower right. Sena's subtitle text overlaps the panel, and the second inventory row ('Spoiled meat 1') is clipped.
fpp-hud.suggested_fix: Make the help panel toggle with F1/H (off after the first minutes) or replace it with short contextual hints. Never place it over the lower-right weapon area or the subtitle band.

fpp-hud.title: First-person axe and torch viewmodels look oversized
fpp-hud.repro: First person, draw the axe (2), then light the torch (4).
fpp-hud.evidence: g_v.png: the axe head is cropped by the top of the screen with a huge handle up the right side. The torch fills the left third with its flame at upper-left. The axe head reads like a mallet block.
fpp-hud.suggested_fix: Scale the viewmodel axe and torch to about 0.7x and lower them. Hold the axe angled forward with the head in view (lower-right third). Give the axe head a wedge or bevel so it reads as an axe.

fpp-hud.title: Help panel overlaps the lower-right HUD in every gameplay screenshot (still open)
fpp-hud.repro: Continue the user's save at 1280x720. Without any key press, the 12-line help panel sits on the lower right.
fpp-hud.evidence: Seen in every shots/qa_save image (mid_*, perf_*, rest_night_reload.jpg, v1ch7_load3.jpg). It covers the E prompt pill ('Rest until da…', 'Share a meal wit…', 'Dismount Da…'), the inventory chips and the fps readout.
fpp-hud.suggested_fix: Hide the panel by default and toggle it with F1/H. Show one contextual hint line instead, kept clear of the prompt pill and inventory.

riding.title: Tame horse's E prompt overrides Sit with Sena, shared meal, revive and story beats
riding.repro: In chapter hearth or later, place a campfire with Sena nearby. Stand on a bench spot with the tame horse within 2.6 m. The prompt reads 'Ride Dawn' instead of 'Sit with Sena'.
riding.evidence: In shots/qa_story/c03_horse_vs_sit.png the prompt shows 'E Ride Dawn' next to the fire. findTarget() (main.js ~2008) returns wp4Target(p) first. That runs before wpnTarget, cmbTarget (revive a downed Sena), the shared meal, arcTarget and structTarget (the fire), so the horse wins every E action within 2.6 m.
riding.suggested_fix: Move the tame-horse branch of wp4Target after the shared meal, cmb, arc and struct targets, or return it only when nothing else matches. Another option is to require the camera to look at the horse, or keep a 1.2 m radius when another target exists. Keep 'Dismount' first while riding.

riding.title: Mounting and dismounting are instant teleports
riding.repro: Stand next to the tame horse and press E (Ride), then press E (Dismount). Aro snaps onto the saddle and snaps 1.3 m to the side in one frame. Sena does the same.
riding.evidence: mount() (main.js 526-535) does `P.pos.copy(o.root.position)` and sets the seat at once. dismount() (537-551) does `P.pos.set(hp.x + rx*1.3, ...)` and clearSeat(P). There is no timed phase, clip or blend.
riding.suggested_fix: Add a 0.6-0.8 s mount phase: face the horse's left side, play a climb/jump clip (UAL Jump_Start or a hop) while lerping the pelvis to the saddle, then hand over to the ride IK. Dismount is the reverse, a slide down with a landing dip, with input locked for that time.

riding.title: Tame horse's E prompt takes priority over 'Sit with Sena'
riding.repro: With a tamed horse standing within 2.6 m of the fire where Sena sits, approach the fire: the prompt shows 'Ride <name>' or 'Feed <name>' and pressing E mounts the horse instead of sitting with Sena.
riding.evidence: main.js:2010 findTarget: 'const w4 = wp4Target(p); if (w4 || P.ride) return w4;' runs before every other target. wp4Target returns Ride or Feed for any tame horse within 2.6 m.
riding.suggested_fix: Only return the horse target first while riding or taming. Otherwise compute it and compare: let structure, Sena and seat targets win when the horse is not the nearest (horse distance > seat or fire distance minus 0.5), or move the wp4Target check after structTarget and the ARC/ROM targets. Keep 'Dismount' as the only target while riding.

riding.title: Mounting and dismounting are instant teleports
riding.repro: Stand next to the tamed horse and press E: Aro snaps onto the saddle in one frame. Press E while riding: he snaps to 1.3 m beside the horse, standing, and Sena snaps off the other side.
riding.evidence: main.js:526-549: mount() does 'P.pos.copy(o.root.position)' plus seatOn on the next frame; dismount() does 'P.pos.set(hp.x + rx*1.3, ...)' and clearSeat(P) with no transition.
riding.suggested_fix: Add a 0.5-0.7 s mount and dismount: lerp P from the side point to the saddle (and back) with an arc in Y, blend the 'ride' pose weight 0 to 1, and lock input meanwhile (camShot-free). For Sena, delay her by 0.3 s. For the visual, use a UAL jump or step-up clip if one exists, or the crouch pose plus vertical lift.

riding.title: Rider arms locked in a stiff 'steering wheel' pose; no gait motion; no reins
riding.repro: G.tame() at Horse Meadow (175,40); G.ride(0,1,5,true) with S.tools.saddle=true; view from the side.
riding.evidence: shots/qa_wh/g_r2.png, g_r.png, g_t.png: both forearms stick out level with the fists together in mid-air, in exactly the same pose at idle, walk and gallop. The torso stays rigidly upright at a gallop. The legs bend like sitting on a chair, with the feet forward at the horse's shoulder, instead of straddling its sides.
riding.suggested_fix: For pose 'ride': IK both hands to points on the mane or withers (or a simple rein line), with a gait-driven forward lean and hip sway that grows with hv. Bend the knees down along the barrel and add a small vertical bounce at trot/gallop.

riding.title: Mount and dismount are instant teleports
riding.repro: Stand by your tame horse; G.dismount(), then G.mount(), while logging P.h.root.position every frame.
riding.evidence: Dismount: root moves 1.29 m sideways and drops 1.15 m in a single frame (190.24,5.62 -> 191.53,4.47). Mount: x snaps 1.3 m in one frame; only y eases afterwards. The code does P.pos.copy(o.root.position) in mount() and P.pos.set in dismount().
riding.suggested_fix: Add a 0.6-0.8 s mount/dismount phase: lock input, blend the root along a short arc (side step, up, swing the leg over), and blend from the stand pose to 'ride' (and back) with h.blends. Do the same for Sena's two-up seat.

riding.title: Horse E prompt beats 'Sit with Sena' (and meals, revive, story beats)
riding.repro: Finished campfire with Sena within 15 m; stand 1.6 m from the fire, so findTarget() gives 'Sit with Sena'. Move the tame horse 1.6 m away: findTarget() now gives 'Feed Dawn (3 berries)'.
riding.evidence: Measured labels: no horse -> 'Sit with Sena'; horse within 2.6 m -> 'Feed Dawn (3 berries)'. In findTarget(), wp4Target runs first: `const w4 = wp4Target(p); if (w4 || P.ride) return w4;`
riding.suggested_fix: Move wp4Target below the meal/CMB/ARC/structure targets, or only let it win when the horse is the closest thing and in front of the player (a facing-dot test). Keep 'Dismount' while riding.

riding.title: First E on your own horse each day feeds her (uses berries) instead of riding
riding.repro: Own a horse and carry 3+ berries or 2 grain; walk up to her and press E to ride.
riding.evidence: wp4Target returns 'Feed Dawn (3 berries)' before 'Ride Dawn' whenever fedDay !== day. The first E eats 3 berries, and she then wanders off after the 2 s eat stun, so the second E often finds no target (seen in the test).
riding.suggested_fix: Make E always 'Ride <name>' and move feeding to a secondary action (hold E, or F 'feed'). At least keep her standing (stun) for 4-5 s after feeding.

riding.title: No saddle or reins model on the horse after crafting the saddle
riding.evidence: g_t.png and g_r2.png: bare horse back, no saddle, blanket or reins. The saddle only unlocks canter/gallop in code.
riding.suggested_fix: Add a simple hide saddle pad plus a rope rein mesh, parented to the Torso2 bone and shown when S.tools.saddle is set. The rider's hands can then IK to the reins.

riding.title: Sena does not hold on when riding two-up
riding.repro: Mount with Sena within 10 m (two-up); view from the side or behind.
riding.evidence: g_t.png: Sena sits behind Aro with her hands on her own knees. Aro's back spear shaft runs 0.14-0.17 m from her head and left hand.
riding.suggested_fix: IK Sena's hands to Aro's waist or pelvis sides while N.ride. While two-up, move Aro's back spear to the horse's flank or lay it flatter.

riding.title: Persistent 'E Dismount Dawn' prompt sits at screen centre the whole ride
riding.repro: Ride in third or first person.
riding.evidence: g_r2 (panel 4), g_t (panel 4) and g_fr: the prompt pill stays over the view ahead (in first person, right over the horse's head and the road).
riding.suggested_fix: Hide the Dismount prompt after a few seconds of riding, or move it to the bottom hint row while P.ride.

world-caves.title: Lio has no marker on the map or minimap
world-caves.repro: After Lio is born (or after G.spawnKid), open the map (M) and look at the minimap.
world-caves.evidence: In shots/qa_story/d02_map_lio.png the legend lists You, Sena, Horse, Quest, Cave, Landmark, Ford, Deer, Wolves, Pin and Buildings, but no child. drawMap (main.js ~7896-7906) draws villagers and Sena but never loops over `kids`, and drawMini does not either.
world-caves.suggested_fix: Add `for (const c of kids) { marker(g, ...toMap(c.pos.x,c.pos.z), 'lio', 1.2); label(..., c.k.name); }` to drawMap and drawMini, plus a legend entry with a distinct colour.

world-caves.title: Map labels pile up at home and the meadow ('Home'/'Sena'/quest, 'Horse Meadow'/'Dawn')
world-caves.repro: Open the map (M) with Aro and Sena at home and the horse in the meadow.
world-caves.evidence: In shots/qa_story/d02_map_lio.png, 'Home' and 'Sena' are drawn on top of each other under the quest diamond and the player arrow, and the 'Dawn' label sits on 'Horse Meadow'.
world-caves.suggested_fix: Add simple label collision avoidance: offset a label when it overlaps one already drawn, or skip the Sena label when she is within 6 m of the player. Draw the quest diamond above the labels.

world-caves.title: Cave interior very dark beyond the torch radius
world-caves.repro: In chapter cave at 12:00, enter Echo Hollow 6-14 m past the mouth and look deeper in.
world-caves.evidence: In shots/qa_story/b01_echo_mouth_14m.png and b02_echo_mouth_6m.png, everything outside Sena's torch pool is near-black and the cave walls are unreadable. This is the known open item.
world-caves.suggested_fix: Raise the cave ambient/hemisphere floor a little (a cool fill of about 0.06-0.1). Add a weak bounce light that follows the torch with a larger distance, and light the cave sconces automatically once discovered.

world-caves.title: Cave interiors are pitch black past the torch; from inside, the mouth renders black and dome gaps show white sky
world-caves.repro: G.time(12); teleport to Echo Hollow centre (k=G.caves.list[0]; G.tp(k.x+k.dir[0]*2,k.z+k.dir[1]*2)), torch lit (T), first person. Looking at the back wall (yaw 0.907): everything beyond about 3 m of the torch is black and the cave paintings are invisible. Turning toward the mouth (yaw+PI): the arch and the outside are solid black, and jagged pure-white shapes appear in the ceiling near the arch (sky through gaps between the dome, tube and boulders).
world-caves.evidence: shots/qa-fpp/c05_echo_center_torch.jpg (black), c06_echo_center_lookout.jpg (black mouth, white holes), g_c03.jpg. world.js:517-524 cuts hemi light by 92% and sun by 100% at depth 1, and turns the fog to 0x050403 with density +0.02, so the daylit exterior seen from inside is fogged to black. caves.js tube is a half-cylinder whose ends meet the lumpy dome with no seal.
world-caves.suggested_fix: Keep a cave ambient floor (hemi at 0.15-0.2 rather than 0.08, warm-grey). Add a weak bounce PointLight just inside the mouth that scales with daylight, so the entrance zone glows. Don't fog the outside: lower the cave fog density, or apply it only to geometry inside (use a distance-from-mouth fade instead of global fog). Seal the tube-dome joint with an extra rock ring or extend the tube 0.5 m into the dome, and make dome/tube materials double-sided or add backing rocks over the gaps. Light the paintings with the sconce sooner (Sena lights it on first entry).

world-caves.title: Echo Hollow entrance is buried under a pile of boulders
world-caves.repro: G.time(12); k=G.caves.list[0]; G.tp(k.mouth[0]+k.dir[0]*14, k.mouth[1]+k.dir[1]*14); G.yaw=0.907 (facing the cave). At 14 m and 30 m the mouth reads as a thin dark slot under a heap of dark green-tinted low-poly boulders. The two 'over the arch' rocks and six side rocks cover most of the arch, and the hill behind is a smooth cone with banded texture.
world-caves.evidence: shots/qa-fpp/c01_echo_fpp_14m.jpg, c02_echo_fpp_30m.jpg. caves.js:178-190: side rocks at lateral TUBE+0.8+sc*1.15 with scale 1.8-2.6 at s=R+3..R+8 (they straddle the mouth at R+5); arch rocks at floor+TUBE+sc*0.9 for s=R+2 and R+4.6.
world-caves.suggested_fix: For the side rocks, push them to s >= R+6.5 (in front of and beside the mouth, not over it) and add 1.0 to the lateral offset. Drop the second arch rock and lift the first to floor+TUBE+sc*1.3 set back to s=R+1.5, so it frames the lintel instead of blocking it. Exclude any rock whose projected bounds overlap the arch (|lat|<TUBE+0.5 and y<floor+TUBE+0.5). Tint the rocks to match the hill's rock texture instead of the green-black.

world-caves.title: Standing stones render almost black in daylight
world-caves.repro: G.time(9); G.tp(150,-45); G.yaw=-Math.PI/2 (looking at the stone circle). The monoliths are flat near-black slabs with no visible stone texture, even in the morning sun.
world-caves.suggested_fix: In landmarks.js, use the rock texture (rockTexture()) with a lighter grey-ochre base colour (about 0x8a8478), roughness 0.95, and add a lichen tint so the stones read in daylight. Check that the normals aren't inverted (the faces look unlit).

world-caves.title: First-person torch is oversized and its flame sits near the centre of the screen as two blobs
world-caves.repro: Give the torch (G.S.tools.torch=true, T), first person, and look ahead in a cave. The shaft fills the lower-left quarter up to the screen centre, and the flame shows as two side-by-side orange lobes at about 45% of the screen height, close to the crosshair.
world-caves.suggested_fix: Lower the torch viewmodel and push it outward (hand at about x -0.32, y -0.38 in camera space), shorten its visible length, and keep the flame below the lower-left third. Merge the two flame sprites into one with a flicker, or offset the halo sprite so they overlap instead of sitting side by side.

world-caves.title: Lio has no map or minimap marker
world-caves.repro: Reach the family chapters and open the map (M).
world-caves.evidence: drawMap/drawMini draw markers for the horse and Sena only; there is no loop over kids. The code is unchanged since QA round 1.
world-caves.suggested_fix: Add a 'kid' marker and a 'Lio' label in drawMap and drawMini for each kids entry, plus a legend row.

world-caves.title: Cave interior is pitch black after loading inside Echo Hollow, with white specks in the dome (still open)
world-caves.repro: Save inside Echo Hollow at 14:00 (G.tp(-138,-108)) with no torch, then reload and Continue.
world-caves.evidence: mid_cave_b.jpg: the screen is fully black except Aro's faint silhouette and bright white sky gaps at the dome top. Frame rate inside the cave drops to 36-40 vs 55-60 outside (s2, vsync on).
world-caves.suggested_fix: Add a faint ambient or hemisphere fill inside caves, scaled by world.env.cave, so walls read at about 5-10% brightness without the torch. Close the dome gaps (seal the mesh seams, or add backfaces so sky can't show through).

sitting-home.title: Sena never sits by the hearth on New Life nights (she only goes to a campfire)
sitting-home.repro: In chapter newlife, with a house, hearth and bed and no campfire within 40 m, set G.time(20.5) and wait near the house. Sena does not move to the hearth, even though her chapter line is 'Come and sit with me by the hearth, Aro.'
sitting-home.evidence: updateSena (main.js ~8195): `const fire = structs.find((s) => s.kind === 'fire'); const night = world.env.night > 0.6 && fire && ...` then walkTo(fire). Nothing in updateSena reads S.home.hearth or homeHouse().hearthW.
sitting-home.suggested_fix: At night, when homeHouse() has a finished hearth and Aro is within about 40 m, send Sena to h.hearthW plus an offset and play the sit or sitTalk pose. Prefer this to the campfire in newlife (and seeds/village). Offer 'Sit with Sena by the hearth' as an E target that reuses sitTogether, with a hearth seat pair.

sitting-home.title: Epilogue time skip (400 days) does not match 'Many winters pass' or the epilogue lines
sitting-home.repro: Finish newlife and enter the village epilogue. The clock reads Day ~401, so Lio is just over a year old, but the lines say she learned to ride before she could run, and the scene shows her grown on the horse.
sitting-home.evidence: epilogue() (main.js 6731) sets `S.day += 400`. The fade text is 'Many winters pass…'. Shot e03_epilogue_c.png shows 'Day 401 · 08:00'.
sitting-home.suggested_fix: Skip several years (for example S.day += 365*6) or hide the day counter in the epilogue. Keep kidScale consistent with the shown age. Book II expects eighteen winters, so set the epilogue age with that in mind.

sitting-home.title: Quest marker missing for early chapters (awaken, fire, hunt, shelter, clay, seeds)
sitting-home.repro: Start a new game. The goal 'Drink from the river' has no marker on the map or minimap. The same is true for 'Dig 8 clay at the riverbank' and 'Gather wild grain'.
sitting-home.evidence: CH entries for awaken, fire, hunt, shelter, clay and seeds have no `where`, so questAt() returns null. In a01_card.png the minimap has no quest diamond.
sitting-home.suggested_fix: Add `where` to these chapters: awaken/fire → the nearest river bank (riverX(P.pos.z)) until drank or fibre is done; hunt → the nearest herd; clay → the nearest clay field node; seeds → the nearest grain field.

sitting-home.title: Lio has no map marker
sitting-home.repro: Reach the family chapters with Lio spawned (G.kids non-empty), then open the map (M) or check the minimap. Sena, villagers, the horse and herds get markers, Lio does not.
sitting-home.evidence: main.js drawMap (7884-7910) draws POIs, structures, the horse, the quest, herds, wolves, villagers, Sena, the pin, the spear and the player, with no loop over kids. The minimap (7856-7875) also has no kid marker.
sitting-home.suggested_fix: In drawMap and the minimap, add 'for (const c of kids) { const [x,y]=toMap(c.pos.x,c.pos.z); marker(g,x,y,'sena',1.1); label(x,y,c.name||'Lio'); }' with its own small glyph (a smaller Sena dot in a lighter colour), and add 'Lio' to the legend.

sitting-home.title: Sena does not sit by the hearth on New Life nights
sitting-home.repro: Chapter 'newlife' (G.setCh('newlife')) with the house built and the hearth upgrade, at night (G.time(21)). Sena walks to the outdoor fire (or idles), not to the indoor hearth, although the chapter line is 'Come and sit with me by the hearth'.
sitting-home.evidence: main.js updateSena (about 8196): 'const night = world.env.night > 0.6 && fire && ...; if (night) walkTo(N, fire.x + 1.7, fire.z - 0.9, ...)': only the outdoor fire struct. There is no hearth branch (h.hearthW exists at 1971).
sitting-home.suggested_fix: In updateSena's night branch: if the house is built with a hearth (S.home.hearth) and the chapter is at or after 'newlife' (or always once a hearth exists), walkTo the hearthW plus an offset inside the house and set N.sit with the seated pose facing the hearth. Add 'Sit with Sena by the hearth' to structTarget there.

sitting-home.title: Berry bush stays inside a hut or house built on top of it, poking through the bed
sitting-home.repro: New story game, G.setCh('shelter'); G.place('hut',10,4,0); G.finishSites(); G.time(21.5); rest in the hut. A leafy bush fills the head end of the bed in the sit, lie and wake shots. The same happens when the player places any structure over one of the near-spawn berry bushes from the build menu.
sitting-home.evidence: shots/qa-rst/05_sit.jpg, 06_lie.jpg, 08_wake_2.jpg. Instance query: Leaves_NormalTree at (10.45, 2.31), scale 0.88, inside the hut (r = 2.3). placeStruct marks the berry node gone and hides only its berries mesh. The bush body is a separate Field('bush') in world.js:274, which is not in world.fields, and its collider stays as well. world.clear() only clears grass carpets.
sitting-home.suggested_fix: world.js: keep the bush Fields (e.g. world.decor = [bushFields]) and expose them. In placeStruct (main.js:1831), hide bush nodes within radius + 0.6 too (scale 0 via Field.set) and turn their colliders off (addCollider returns the collider; store it on n.col). Alternatively make world.clear() hide decor bushes as well as grass.

sitting-home.title: Bed blanket is a huge lumpy hump that hides Sena and the held hands
sitting-home.repro: Rest in the house with bed and hearth, together. Hold the night with G.restHold('night') and view G.restCam('end'). Also seen in the hut and the cave.
sitting-home.evidence: shots/qa-rst/18_house_lie.jpg, 19_house_hold.jpg, 06_lie.jpg, 33_cave_bed.jpg. The blanket rises about 0.4-0.5 m over Sena's curled knees (RT.sHip 1.25 and sKnee 1.35 push them up), so only her hand by the pillow shows. The hold point is at matY+0.07 (probe: holdPt y 4.27, mattress 4.20), beneath the blanket, so the holding-hands feature is never visible. The near edge is a hard straight seam lying across Aro's arm.
sitting-home.suggested_fix: In rstDrape, cap the drape height (e.g. min(top, 0.22)) and scale the body points by 0.6. Keep the blanket below the hold point by shortening zTop (head[0][1] + 0.75) or lifting R.holdPt above the drape top, so the hands rest on top of the blanket. Reduce Sena's knee curl (sHip ~0.8) so her shoulder and face stay visible from cam.end.

sitting-home.title: Tame horse's 'Ride' E prompt overrides 'Sit with Sena' at the campfire (known open item, still reproduces)
sitting-home.repro: Tame a horse (G.spawn('horse',3,-20,{horse:true,wild:true}); G.tame(o); G.dismount()). Place a fire at (0,-25), stand at (0,-22.6) at 19:30 with Sena close, and put the horse 2.1 m away. The target is 'Ride Dawn'. Move the horse away and the target becomes 'Sit with Sena'.
sitting-home.evidence: Measured: withHorse 'Ride Dawn' (dh 2.1), noHorse 'Sit with Sena'. findTarget() returns wp4Target first (main.js:2010) before any struct or fire target.
sitting-home.suggested_fix: In findTarget, call wp4Target only when the horse is nearer than the closest struct target (fire within radius + 1.6), or give fire/sit targets priority when Aro faces the fire. Simplest: if a finished fire is within 3.2 m and Sena can sit, skip wp4Target's 'Ride' label unless Aro faces the horse (dot of facing and horse direction > 0.5).

sitting-home.title: Lio has no marker on the map or minimap (known open item, still reproduces)
sitting-home.repro: Get Lio born (newlife chapter goals done, rest at home), then open the map (M) or look at the minimap in the village epilogue.
sitting-home.evidence: drawMini (main.js:7854) and drawMap (7891) place markers for Sena, the horse, animals and POIs, but never iterate kids[]. Shot 26_after_birth.jpg shows the minimap with no child marker.
sitting-home.suggested_fix: Add put(c.pos.x, c.pos.z, 'sena', true, 0.7) or a new 'kid' marker for each kid in drawMini, and a marker plus label(c.k.name) in drawMap.

sitting-home.title: Sena never sits by the hearth on New Life nights (known open item, still reproduces)
sitting-home.repro: Chapter newlife with house, hearth, cradle and nursery. G.time(21) and wait 15 s near the house.
sitting-home.evidence: Sena stands next to Aro outside (N at -12.6, 17.1, pose null, sit 0). No code in updateSena references the hearth or newlife; the only hearth uses are the light, comfort and ROM scenes.
sitting-home.suggested_fix: In updateSena, when CH id is 'newlife', the night (S.time >= 19), S.home.hearth is true and Sena is free (nFree()), walk her to toWorld(home, [1.3, 0, -0.6]), face the hearthPt, and set h.pose 'sit' (or 'sitTalk') until rest or morning. Add a short line once per night.

sitting-home.title: Grown Lio (epilogue) sleeps on top of the tiny cradle, legs and head hanging out
sitting-home.repro: Village epilogue after the birth (Lio at scale 0.62, cradle built). Night rest at the house; look at the cradle (local 1.8, 1.2).
sitting-home.evidence: shots/qa-rst/28_cradle.jpg: Lio about 0.9 m long (head z 12.65, foot 13.54) lies over a cradle about 0.5 m long, with no blanket. kidBed(): S.home.cradle && i === 0 always picks the cradle, whatever the age or scale.
sitting-home.suggested_fix: In kidBed, use the cradle only while kidScale(k) < 0.55 (an infant). Otherwise use a small bedroll in the nursery (S.home.nursery: local [-4.8, 0.2, 0]) or the parents' bed (rstKids already supports a child between them). Drape a small blanket over her (reuse makeBlanket).

sitting-home.title: Grass grows through the nursery floor
sitting-home.repro: Build the nursery upgrade (G.homeUpgrade('nursery')) and look into the annex from inside the house (rest cam during the wake).
sitting-home.evidence: shots/qa-rst/25_wake_lio.jpg: green grass blades on the nursery planks. placeStruct clears only radius 4.4 + 0.4 around the house centre, and the annex reaches to local x of about -6.2. applyHome adds annexCol but never calls world.clear.
sitting-home.suggested_fix: In applyHome, when S.home.nursery is set, call world.clear(w.x, w.z, 2.4) at the annex centre (toWorld(h, [-4.8, 0, 0])), next to the annexCol line.

sitting-home.title: Hot-spring soak: Aro and Sena sit on top of the water, hips above the surface
sitting-home.repro: Go to the spring (G.landmarks.spring = -105, -62), stand 5 m away with Sena near, and press E on 'Rest in the warm water (with Sena)'.
sitting-home.evidence: shots/qa-rst/32_spring.jpg. Measured: water surface y 9.93 (basin + 0.6), Aro's pelvis 10.09, head 10.73. The seat is sp.y + 0.2, so they look like they hover on the surface. Steam sprites at opacity 0.22 are barely visible by day, so it doesn't read as a hot spring.
sitting-home.suggested_fix: In soakTogether's seat(), set seat y to LMK.spring.water - 0.85 (pelvis about 0.3 below the surface, shoulders above). Raise the steam sprite opacity to 0.35-0.4 by day, and give the water a slightly milky tint.

sitting-home.title: House windows glow cream from inside at night (the emissive box is visible on both sides)
sitting-home.repro: Rest in the house at night; the walk-in shot (cam.walk) and the cradle view show the windows.
sitting-home.evidence: shots/qa-rst/16_house_walk.jpg, 28_cradle.jpg: bright flat cream panes inside a dark room at 20:40. The windows are BoxGeometry(0.9, 0.9, t + 0.04) with glowM (entities.js:342) running through the wall, and main drives the emissive by night.
sitting-home.suggested_fix: Make the window box face only outward: use a PlaneGeometry on the outer face with glowM, and a dark blue-black glass plane (night sky colour, low emissive) on the inner face. Alternatively split it into two thin boxes with different materials.

sitting-home.title: The hearth has no fire: logs and an ember disc only, no flame or chimney smoke
sitting-home.repro: Build the hearth and rest at night; the hearth sits unlit in the corner of the lie shot.
sitting-home.evidence: shots/qa-rst/18_house_lie.jpg: a stone ring with orange-tinted logs and no flame. entities.js:313-317 builds only stones, an emberM disc and logs. The comfort text and dream lines talk about a crackling hearth.
sitting-home.suggested_fix: Reuse the campfire flame (the fire structure's flame sprites/mesh plus flicker) inside hearthG, scaled to 0.6, and visible only at night or when someone is home. Add a smoke puff loop from the chimney top.

sitting-home.title: Sena's 'You didn't come home last night' plays when Aro slept at home and Sena was away
sitting-home.repro: Village/house: G.N.pos.set(60,0,60) at 22:00. Rest in the house (menu note: 'Sena is too far away to join you'), then bring Sena back near Aro.
sitting-home.evidence: Sub after the solo night in the home house: 'Sena: You didn't come home last night. I kept the fire going for you.' The APART lines are chosen without checking where Aro slept (rstTick).
sitting-home.suggested_fix: Record where Aro slept (S.c.apartWhere = R.s.kind, and whether it was homeHouse()). If he slept at home, use a different pair, e.g. 'I couldn't get back before dark. Was the bed cold without me?'; keep the current lines for nights he spent away from home.

sitting-home.title: The birth line 'Look at her hands, Aro' plays after the jump to the village epilogue
sitting-home.repro: Complete the newlife goals and rest at home: the birth card shows, the wake runs, the chapter jumps to 'Epilogue · The Village' (day 23 → 423), and then the birth line plays.
sitting-home.evidence: shots/qa-rst/26_after_birth.jpg: the aerial village epilogue (Day 423) with the subtitle 'Sena: Look at her hands, Aro…'. maybeBirth uses a wall-clock setTimeout(5200) instead of the wake phase. Lio is also never framed during the wake, which looks at the bed, not the cradle.
sitting-home.suggested_fix: Move the two lines into the wake phase (e.g. when R.phase === 'wake' and R.t > 1.6, replacing the morning line on the birth night). Add a wake camera shot on the cradle (toWorld(s, kidBed(s, 0))) for that night. Hold the chapter advance until rstDone.

sitting-home.title: rstAbort() never clears busy: aborting a rest leaves all input locked
sitting-home.repro: G.lie('both', true) then G.lie('both', false) (or any path that calls rstAbort while R.on). Afterwards G.mat.state().busy === true and the keydown handler returns early (menuOpen || busy), so movement, E, Tab and so on do nothing. At the fire, survFire's 'Sit with Sena' disappears because it checks !busy.
sitting-home.evidence: Measured busy:true after G.lie(false), and the fire prompt fell back to 'Campfire — bring raw meat…'. rstBegin sets busy = true (main.js:~2793), but rstAbort (3088-3102) resets everything except busy. die() is masked by downed(), which handles busy, but any future abort path soft-locks.
sitting-home.suggested_fix: In rstAbort, when R.on was true, set busy = false (and P.rest = N.rest = 0, already done) before cine(false). Also restore s.col.off for the shelter.

sitting-home.title: Wake shot crops Aro's stretch; the hand-back camera faces the thatch roof or the house side wall
sitting-home.repro: Rest in the hut and let the wake run; then rest in the house and watch the hand-back after rstDone.
sitting-home.evidence: shots/qa-rst/08_wake_2.jpg: in the hut, Aro's raised hands and the top of his head are cut off by the letterbox (cam.wake [0.15, 1.6, 1.6] is too low and close). 09_after.jpg: after the hand-back the thatch cone fills about 2/3 of the screen. 21_house_done.jpg: Aro faces the west wall corner by the bed and the camera is pressed to the side wall.
sitting-home.suggested_fix: Hut cam.wake: pull back and up (e.g. [0.4, 2.0, 1.9], wakeLook y 1.2). In the release, pitch the camera down to about -0.05 inside the hut (camPitch 0.1 points up into the cone) and clamp it to the room height. House: set D.exit to a point facing the door ([-1.2, 0.9]) so the release looks out of the doorway.

sitting-home.title: Floor-bed sit phase: Aro is on all fours with his head down instead of kneeling
sitting-home.repro: Rest in the hut (a low bed); hold at the sit phase with G.restHold('sit').
sitting-home.evidence: shots/qa-rst/05_sit.jpg: the 'work' base pose for low beds puts Aro on hands and knees with his arms hanging, so it reads as crawling, not kneeling down to lie.
sitting-home.suggested_fix: For low beds, use a kneel-sit (the kneeling seated frame of 'sit', or 'work' with the spine pitched up and the hands on the thighs through ik2) for about 0.6 s before lying back.

sitting-home.title: Sena never sits by the hearth on New Life nights
sitting-home.repro: Night at home with the house and hearth built.
sitting-home.evidence: updateSena's night branch only checks structs.find(kind==='fire') and walks to fire.x+1.7. The hearth is not considered (code unchanged).
sitting-home.suggested_fix: At night, prefer the house hearth (S.home.hearth) when one exists and Aro is within about 40 m. Walk her inside and play the sit pose facing the hearth.

sitting-home.title: A migrated v1 'village' save loads the epilogue without Lio
sitting-home.repro: Load a v1 save (no storyV) with ch: 7 and Continue.
sitting-home.evidence: s11: 'v1ch7 load1 village day=414 … kids=0'. The epilogue jumps to day 414 and builds 4 village houses, but the grown daughter is missing (screenshot v1ch7_load3.jpg). The same happens with a corrupt chId plus ch 99: the save is clamped to the last chapter and the player lands in the epilogue (s1 'bad chId').
sitting-home.suggested_fix: In migration (or epilogue()), when reaching village or newlife with S.kids empty, create Lio (grown, at the epilogue age). For an unknown chId, keep the save's own valid index, and never jump straight to the epilogue chapter unless the save already had village=true.

weapons.title: Wolves spawn in a random direction with no pine-forest preference
weapons.repro: From chapter hunt on, wait for night with no wolves alive. Where the pack spawns has nothing to do with the biome.
weapons.evidence: EVENTS.wolves (main.js 926-932): `a = rand()*6.283; landSpot(P.pos.x + sin(a)*46, P.pos.z + cos(a)*46, 0, 12)` with no biomeAt check. The roaming logic shows no pine bias either.
weapons.suggested_fix: Sample 8-12 angles and pick the spawn spot where biomeAt(x,z) is pine, falling back to random. Bias their wander or home targets toward the nearest pine area during the day.

weapons.title: Wolves spawn in a random direction, with no preference for the pine forest
weapons.repro: Reach the 'hunt' chapter and wait for the night (or call G.EVENTS.wolves()) at home, several times. Packs appear 46 m away in any direction, including the open meadow and the river side.
weapons.evidence: main.js:926-928 EVENTS.wolves: 'a = rand()*6.283; landSpot(P.pos.x + sin(a)*46, P.pos.z + cos(a)*46, 0, 12)'. No biomeAt check.
weapons.suggested_fix: Sample 8 candidate angles, score each with biomeAt(x,z)==='pine' (plus 2) and distance to the pine edge, and pick the best (with some randomness). Then have the pack approach out of the tree line. Also make wolves retreat toward the pine biome when w.leave is set.

weapons.title: Axe head clips through the left thigh and calf when walking and sprinting
weapons.repro: Axe sheathed on hipL; hold W (walk) or W+Shift (sprint); measure the distance from the axe head (local z 0.36-0.46) to the thigh_l-calf_l and calf_l-foot_l segments, or view from the side.
weapons.evidence: Minimum distance from the axe head to the thigh bone axis is 0.051 m at walk and 0.052 m at sprint, and 0.052 m to the calf (the thigh radius is about 0.08 m). Idle is 0.165 m. Shot g_ss.png shows the head and handle passing through the back of the thigh and calf on the back stride.
weapons.suggested_fix: Move the hipL fit further out and back (larger x/negative z) and tilt the head forward, or carry the axe through the belt at the back hip. Alternatively, swing the hipL socket with the pelvis yaw only, not the thigh, and clamp a minimum offset from thigh_l each frame.

weapons.title: Spear sticks up out of the water from the back while swimming (third person)
weapons.repro: Swim in the river (e.g. G.tp(59.5,-20.5)) holding W, with the spear in its back slot; view in third person.
weapons.evidence: Spear tip is 0.65 m above the root while swimming (G.wpn.ends). Shots sw1/sw2 in g_sw.png show the shaft poking diagonally out of the water. Only the first-person path hides it.
weapons.suggested_fix: While P.swim, use a flatter 'swim' back fit lying along the spine (shaft roughly horizontal, tip toward the feet), or tuck it under the arm; blend it in and out with the swim weight.

weapons.title: Wolves spawn at a random 46 m bearing with no pine-forest preference
weapons.repro: Any night after the hunt chapter: EVENTS.wolves() fires; check biomeAt at the spawn points.
weapons.evidence: main.js EVENTS.wolves: `a = rand()*6.283; landSpot(P.pos.x + sin(a)*46, ...)`. There is no biome check, so packs come out of open meadow or the riverbank as often as the pines.
weapons.suggested_fix: Try 8-12 bearings and pick the one whose spawn point (and the line toward Aro) has the most 'pine' biome (biomeAt). Fall back to random. Optionally let roaming wolves home toward pine cells by day.

weapons.title: Weapon number key from sheathed only selects the weapon; a second press is needed to draw
weapons.repro: Fists selected and sheathed: press 2 once.
weapons.evidence: State after one press: sel 'axe', st 'sheathed'. A second press draws it (wpnSelect only draws when k === W.sel).
weapons.suggested_fix: From sheathed, a weapon key should select and draw in one press, as in AC. Keep the select-only behaviour only while riding, swimming or busy.

weapons.title: Inventory bar ignores flint tools ('Your hands are empty' while holding a flint axe)
weapons.repro: State with only S.tools.flintaxe (no stone axe) and an empty inventory: draw the axe.
weapons.evidence: hx1.png: chip reads 'Your hands are empty' while held === 'axe'. drawInv only lists S.tools.spear/axe, never flintaxe/flintspear, and it still lists 'Spear' while the spear lies on the ground.
weapons.suggested_fix: In drawInv use hasAxe()/hasSpear() with labels 'Flint axe'/'Flint spear', mark the spear as 'on the ground' when W.spearOut, and never show 'hands are empty' while W.held or torchOn.

weapons.title: A weapon drawn at save time comes back sheathed on load
weapons.repro: Draw the spear and aim (or draw the axe), save, then reload and Continue.
weapons.evidence: s3: before the save wpn {sel:'spear', st:'drawn', held:'spear', aim:true}; after the load {sel:'spear', st:'sheathed', held:null}. The axe behaves the same. wpnLoad always resets st to 'sheathed'.
weapons.suggested_fix: Save S.drawn = W.st === 'drawn'. On load, if it was drawn and no story beat or seat applies, snap the weapon into the hand (no draw animation). Never restore aim.

save-perf.title: Asset load failure leaves the title on 'Loading…' forever, with no error or retry
save-perf.repro: Serve the game while one model or texture fetch fails (seen under heavy load in vite preview: 'anims2.glb not loaded TypeError: Failed to fetch', then GLTFLoader texture errors).
save-perf.evidence: The first QA attempt stayed on the 'Loading…' button for 90 s (shots/qa_story/a00_title.png from that run) and window.G was never defined. main.js:45 `await Promise.all([loadNature(), loadPeople(), loadAnimals(), loadGame()])` has no catch. people.js only guards anims2.glb, and its texture loads still throw.
save-perf.suggested_fix: Wrap the boot in try/catch and show 'Some files failed to load. Retry'. Retry each loadAsync 2-3 times with backoff before giving up.

save-perf.title: WebGL context loss is unhandled: the screen goes white, the game keeps running and saving, and the map base goes blank for good
save-perf.repro: Under memory pressure the GPU process crashed during the run. Verify with G.renderer.getContext().isContextLost() === true. After that the 3D view was solid white for the rest of the session (all shots e02-e05), with the HUD live and PUT /api/save calls continuing. The big map's explored area showed as a flat dark hole: the #mapcanvas pixel at (410,410) was 0,0,0,0, and the minimap showed only parchment, because mapBase (main.js:7712) is painted once at module load and its accelerated 2D canvas lost its contents. After a page reload both were correct again (the minimap showed terrain in i01). The same happens to players on laptop sleep/wake or a GPU driver reset.
save-perf.evidence: shots/qa-fpp/g_e.jpg (white), d01_map720.jpg (dark map holes). The eval returned {lost:true, frame:400}. grep shows no 'webglcontextlost', 'contextrestored' or 'isContextLost' handling in src/.
save-perf.suggested_fix: On renderer.domElement 'webglcontextlost': preventDefault, pause the game and save, and show an overlay 'Graphics were reset - click to continue'. On 'webglcontextrestored', three.js re-uploads; if not, offer a reload that resumes from the save. Repaint mapBase lazily: wrap the painter in a function, call it on first map open and on canvas 'contextrestored' or when isContextLost() is true, or create it with getContext('2d', {willReadFrequently:true}) so it is CPU-backed and survives GPU resets.

save-perf.title: One failed asset load aborts the whole boot with no message or retry
save-perf.repro: Reload the page while the server is slow (it happened at load 45). GLTFLoader logged 'Couldn't load texture t_eye_normal.png / leaves.png / leaf_pine_c.png / t_hair_2_basecolor.jpg' and then threw an uncaught 'Failed to load buffer hair_beard.bin'. window.G was never defined and the title screen never became usable; a second reload worked.
save-perf.evidence: Driver console log after the first reload: EXC 'Error: THREE.GLTFLoader: Failed to load buffer "hair_beard.bin"' at index-*.js:4466. The MAT notes also mention adding 'page-load and reload retries for asset loads that fail under machine load' to their harness.
save-perf.suggested_fix: Wrap the model and texture loads in a retry (2-3 attempts with backoff). If a load still fails, show a 'Could not load assets - Retry' message on the loading screen instead of a silent dead page. Missing textures should fall back to a flat material rather than reject the load.

save-perf.title: Low frame rate: home view draws 828 calls and about 3.0M triangles per frame
save-perf.repro: New game, G.tp(0,4), third person at the start view, then read G.renderer.info.render after a frame.
save-perf.evidence: renderer.info.render {calls:828, triangles:2,967,612, points:2080}, 1394 visible meshes, 1 shadow-casting light, pixelRatio 0.8 (render-quality setting at 80%). The triangle count includes the shadow pass, so the grass and trees are drawn twice.
save-perf.suggested_fix: Profile on a real GPU, but the likely wins are: (1) don't cast shadows from grass and the small decor (castShadow=false on grass instanced meshes); (2) LOD or impostors for trees beyond about 60 m and a lower Q.decor radius; (3) merge or instance the per-tree and per-rock meshes (1394 visible meshes points to individual meshes); (4) cull the cave and landmark groups by distance (cave rock dressing is visible from across the map); (5) a shadow-camera frustum fitted to about 60 m around the player.

save-perf.title: Empty save-status pill visible after New game
save-perf.repro: Start a New game (Survivor) at either resolution. Under the top-right toast an empty dark rounded pill (24x~20 px at right:18px, top:100px) stays on screen with no text.
save-perf.evidence: shots/qa-fpp/a02_hud720.jpg and f01_hud1080.jpg (top right, under 'Click the game to capture the mouse'). The eval showed #savechip textContent '' with style.opacity '1' and className 'panel'.
save-perf.suggested_fix: Only set opacity when the chip has text: in the frame loop use '$('savechip').style.opacity = el.textContent ? Math.min(1, saveFlash) : 0'. Also find out who clears the text (it starts empty in index.html; the new-game path seems to raise saveFlash without calling save()).

save-perf.title: Lost WebGL context leaves a white screen with no message or recovery
save-perf.repro: Under heavy GPU load (here: headless vulkan with load avg about 40, about 3M triangles per frame), the context was lost while holding E at the house site. The screen turned fully white while the HUD kept running.
save-perf.evidence: G.renderer.getContext().isContextLost() === true; renderer.info showed 2.96M triangles and 812 draw calls; shot 12b.jpg. No webglcontextlost handler exists.
save-perf.suggested_fix: Add canvas listeners for 'webglcontextlost' (preventDefault, pause, save, show a 'Graphics reset, click to continue' panel) and 'webglcontextrestored' (reload the page, or rebuild after saving). Consider a lower default triangle budget on 'low' quality.

save-perf.title: Low frame rate: about 1,050 fragmented InstancedMeshes give 800-1,200 draw calls; shadows redrawn every frame
save-perf.repro: New game, stand at (10,10) or Horse Meadow; read renderer.info.render and time renderer.render.
save-perf.evidence: Draw calls 797-1201 and triangles 2.4-3.4M across 7 locations. Median frame 17-23 ms at pixel ratio 0.8 on M4 Metal. renderer.render takes 9.5 ms of a 16.7 ms frame. 1,397 visible meshes, 1,045 of them InstancedMesh averaging about 4 instances each (e.g. 43 'Leaves' meshes holding 160 instances). Field in world.js makes one InstancedMesh per cell per part. 859 visible shadow casters, with shadowMap.needsUpdate every frame on high quality or every second frame otherwise.
save-perf.suggested_fix: Build one InstancedMesh per species/part for the whole field (or 64-128 m cells) and cull with BatchedMesh or per-instance visibility instead of per-cell meshes. Turn off castShadow for flowers, mushrooms and grass-like parts. Update the shadow map every 3-4 frames or only when the sun or player moves more than a threshold. Add distance LOD or skip for small props.

save-perf.title: Auto quality picks the 'high' preset on the user's Apple M4, a main cause of the low frame rate
save-perf.repro: Start Chrome with --use-angle=metal on the M4 MacBook Air and load any save. Esc › Video shows 'auto → high'. In src/quality.js detectQuality, the regex /apple m1|apple gpu/ does not match the GL string 'ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M4, Unspecified Version)', so it falls through to 'high'.
save-perf.evidence: s4/s10 logs: the GL string is 'Apple M4'. At 1470x956 DPR2 with vsync off, home view on auto→high: 867 draw calls, 2.78M tris, 106 fps uncapped, p95 15.6 ms, render buffer 2205x1434 (adaptive pr rose to 1.5). Medium: 470 calls, 1.72M tris, 148 fps, p95 10 ms. Low: 170 fps. On high the frame loop sets shadowMap.needsUpdate every frame (main.js frame()); 883 shadow casters. Turning shadows off alone gave +17% fps. A fanless Air throttles under that sustained load.
save-perf.suggested_fix: In detectQuality, match /apple m\d|apple gpu/ (and any integrated GPU) to 'medium'. Better: pick the preset from the measured frame time in the first 5 s. On every preset, refresh the shadow map every 2nd frame or only when the sun or player moves more than about 0.5 m. Also check the adaptive-resolution rule: with 60 Hz vsync, avg is never under 14 ms, so pr only ever goes down. On 120 Hz screens, or anything not vsync-capped, it climbs to prMax 1.5 (2.25x pixels).

save-perf.title: Shaders compile during play and cause 48-115 ms hitches (program count grows 85 → 106)
save-perf.repro: Load the user's save. Record frame times with requestAnimationFrame while idling at home, galloping on Dawn, sprinting, and starting a wolf fight with the axe drawn. Each max-frame spike lines up with renderer.info.programs going up.
save-perf.evidence: s9 (vsync off): idle home max 114.6 ms as programs went 85→95; gallop max 48.3 ms at 95→98; sprint max 61.4 ms at 98→100; wolves fight max 56.6 ms at 100→101. FPP had no new programs and a max of 11.3 ms. Soak: programs 83→106. Switching to DPR2 compiled another ~36 (progs 137). p95 is otherwise 8-13 ms, so these spikes are the visible stutters.
save-perf.suggested_fix: Warm up shaders behind the title screen. After assets load, call renderer.compileAsync(scene, camera), plus one off-screen render each of a wolf, a horse, a raider, gore decals, the torch, rain, both day and night light counts, and the viewmodel scene. Keep the number of lights fixed (toggle intensity, not visibility or castShadow) so lights don't force recompiles. Give onBeforeCompile materials a stable customProgramCacheKey.

save-perf.title: GPU textures leak on every animal spawn and are never freed (216 → 449 in a 6.5 min soak)
save-perf.repro: Load the user's save. Read G.renderer.info.memory.textures. Call G.EVENTS.wolves(), then remove the wolves (or wait for them to leave in daylight), and read the count again. Repeat 4 times. Then G.spawn('deer', ...) three times.
save-perf.evidence: s7: four wolf rounds: tex 216→232→248→264→280 (+4 per wolf, same after removal); deer +7 each (280→287→294→301). Geometry count stays flat. s5 soak: 216→449 textures with no drop after GC. Each spawned animal's materials have unique uuids (cloned) and no maps, so the leaked textures are most likely the per-SkinnedMesh skeleton bone textures. remove(o) at main.js:786 only does scene.remove and splices the array, and nothing in main.js or animals.js calls dispose().
save-perf.suggested_fix: In remove(o), and in any gore or limb cleanup, traverse o.root. For each SkinnedMesh call o.skeleton.dispose(), and dispose the materials cloned for it. Geometry is shared, so leave it. Or pool and reuse animal rigs per kind instead of cloning on every spawn. Add a soak check: the texture count must come back to its baseline after spawn and remove cycles.

save-perf.title: About 26% of main-thread CPU goes to updating the matrices of about 3,600 objects every frame, most of them static
save-perf.repro: Use an unminified build. Load the user's save at home, then run a 6 s CDP Profiler capture at a 200 µs sampling interval.
save-perf.evidence: s4 profile (self time): projectObject 9.5%, Matrix4.multiplyMatrices 8.6%, Object3D.updateMatrixWorld 8.1%, onQuaternionChange 3.6%, WebGLObjects.update 4.0%, renderBufferDirect 5.2%. The scene has 1,724 top-level children and 3,612 objects. No file in src sets matrixAutoUpdate=false (grep). 162 skinned meshes are visible at home, and 15 human rigs each carry sock_back props.
save-perf.suggested_fix: Set matrixAutoUpdate=false and call updateMatrix() once for static structures, landmarks, rocks, cave meshes, beds and props (structs once rise reaches 1). Group static scenery under one parent with matrixWorldAutoUpdate=false. Skip updateAnimal and mixer updates (and set visible=false) for animals beyond about 120 m or outside the frustum, using a cheaper update rate for distant ones.

save-perf.title: Grass is always drawn (696k triangles plus an 11.5k-instance loop every frame), even inside caves and at night
save-perf.repro: Load any save, stand inside Echo Hollow (G.tp(-138,-108)) and list the visible meshes. The four grass InstancedMeshes (frustumCulled=false) are still drawn. world.js carpet().update loops over every instance each frame.
save-perf.evidence: s4: 'Grass|inst n=4 tris=695780' is the biggest triangle bucket at every spot, including 'echo' (inside the cave) and 'night_home'. The grass update() shows 2.7% self time in the profile. When anything moves, the whole 9000-instance instanceMatrix buffer (about 576 KB) is uploaded again.
save-perf.suggested_fix: Hide the carpets when world.env.cave > 0.5. Run update() only when the player has moved more than about 0.5 m, and spread it over several frames. Upload only the changed range with instanceMatrix.updateRanges. At night or in fog, reduce density (setDensity).

save-perf.title: The minimap canvas redraws every frame
save-perf.repro: Profile any gameplay. updateMap() calls drawMini() every frame (main.js about line 7957).
save-perf.evidence: drawMini takes 2.0% of self time in the s4 home profile. Its contents change slowly: the fog reveal already runs every 0.5 s.
save-perf.suggested_fix: Redraw the minimap at about 10-15 Hz, or only when the player has moved more than 0.5 m or turned more than 2°. Cache the static terrain layer in an offscreen canvas and draw only the markers on top.

save-perf.title: A corrupt save (structs: null) crashes start() and leaves a dead title screen; start() has no try/finally
save-perf.repro: Give the game a save with structs: null (s3, 'structs null' case) and click Continue. You get 'TypeError: R.structs is not iterable' in start(). The HUD never appears, and clicking Continue again throws again. There is no message to the player.
save-perf.evidence: s3.log: '=== structs null 0 playing=false … title=true' and two EXC lines. start() does S = Object.assign(fresh(), data), so a null field overwrites the default. Only inv, home, found, stash and kids get a fallback. playing=true is set only at the very end, so a throw partway through start() (after placeStruct) leaves a half-built world that a second click would build again.
save-perf.suggested_fix: After loading, add a fallback for every array or object field (structs, felled, horse, kids, seen…): Array.isArray(S.structs) || (S.structs = []). Wrap the load body in try/catch. On failure, show 'Save could not be loaded: start new or retry', keep the raw save as a backup key, and set a 'starting' flag at the top of start() so a second click cannot build again.

save-perf.title: Closing the game mid-rest loses the night and leaves the camera in a dark corner of the house
save-perf.repro: Load the user's save. Call G.tp(0,-12); G.time(21); G.rest('dawn'). During the 'night' phase (about 02:52) close the page, which saves through pagehide and the beacon. Reload and Continue.
save-perf.evidence: s11: before the close: restState phase 'night', lieW [1,1], 02:52. After reload: 03:22, standing, busy=false, the 'Rest until dawn' prompt again. No dawn jump, no morning, and the rest is only half credited. Screenshot rest_night_reload.jpg: the camera is wedged in a black house corner at 03:30 with only the window glow boxes visible.
save-perf.suggested_fix: When saving while R.on (in save() or rstSave), finish the rest in the saved data: set time to the target wake hour (day+1) and apply the rested tier, counters and slept_home, as if the night ended. Or save S.restPending and finish the night on load. After a load inside a hut or house, aim camYaw toward the door or the room centre.

save-perf.title: Still open: low frame rate (profiled hotspots)
save-perf.repro: Play the user's save at home or in the far field on the M4 Air.
save-perf.evidence: Home 867-924 draw calls and 2.8-2.9M tris; far field 1,067-1,131 calls and 3.1-3.3M tris, almost all instanced trees and grass. Concrete causes are listed in the separate items above: the high preset on M4, every-frame shadows with 883 casters, runtime shader compiles, about 26% CPU on matrices, always-on grass, every-frame minimap. Uncapped 1280x720 DPR1 runs at 135-150 fps, so the problem is preset choice, fill rate and hitches, not one hot function.
save-perf.suggested_fix: Fix in this order: (1) quality detection for M-series, (2) shader warm-up, (3) shadow update rate and caster count (thin out small rocks, flowers and props), (4) static matrices, (5) grass. Then re-measure p95 and max on the Air at 60 Hz.

save-perf.title: Still open: WebGL context loss has no handler
save-perf.repro: Grep src for 'contextlost', or force WEBGL_lose_context.loseContext() in a session.
save-perf.evidence: There are no 'webglcontextlost' or 'contextrestored' listeners anywhere in src/*.js. Earlier QA saw a white screen while the game kept running and autosaving every 20 s.
save-perf.suggested_fix: On webglcontextlost: preventDefault, pause, stop autosave and show a 'Graphics reset — reloading' overlay. On restore, save and location.reload() (simplest), or rebuild GPU resources.
